name: Balbach Teaching Dimension of Trivial Concepts
proof: For this class, ordinary teaching dimension and recursive teaching dimension are both one. The established sandwich $\mathrm{TD}\ge\mathrm{BTD}\ge\mathrm{RTD}$ therefore forces $\mathrm{BTD}=1$.
references: \cite{zilles2011models,balbach2008measuring}; derived using established TD and RTD values
